name: Haleiwa
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Haleiwa, HI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Haleiwa, Hawaii for 2026: 3 family events, 3 free, with dates checked on host sites.
lede: Haleiwa keeps Christmas with local parades, Santa visits and community events.
celebrates: The North Shore keeps Christmas relaxed. The North Shore Chamber of Commerce hosts the Haleiwa Christmas Parade on Friday, December 11, 2026, from 6:30 to 8:30 pm, along Kamehameha Highway from Weed Circle to Haleiwa Beach Park. Two days later, Surf Santa offers free selfies at Haleiwa Store Lots. Before Christmas, the Kahuku and Waialua public libraries each hold a free Santa Claus Story Time. Waialua, Kahuku, Laie and Sunset Beach have no pages of their own, so their events are listed here.
lastyear: We did not find a 2025 recap on the chamber's site. The chamber's 2026 listing calls this the 24th Annual Haleiwa Christmas Parade, and it lists entry fees of $50 for a business, $25 for a civic group or nonprofit and free for a school or youth group. The listing gives the parade date as Friday, December 11, 2026, and says the road closes at 5:30 pm.
facts: The Haleiwa parade route follows Kamehameha Highway through Haleiwa Main Street, and the chamber says the road closes at 5:30 pm. Surf Santa is held in the Kamehamalu Courtyard at Haleiwa Store Lots and offers free selfies from noon to 2 pm on Sunday, December 13. Kahuku Public and School Library and Waialua Public Library hold their sessions on December 21 and 22, both from 10 to 10:30 am.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride on the North Shore. The nearest is the Hawaiian Railway Society in Ewa Beach, which runs a Holiday Express Train Ride. Pearlridge Center in Aiea also runs the Pearlridge Express Holiday Train, $6 per child for children under 48 inches tall. The Hawaiian Railway Society in Ewa Beach runs a Holiday Express Train Ride, a 90-minute nonstop evening ride decorated with hundreds of lights where riders can wear holiday pajamas.
train_links: Oahu's only operating historic railway, with a Holiday Express Train Ride on restored track.

faq: How does the North Shore celebrate Christmas?
With the Haleiwa Christmas Parade, Surf Santa at Haleiwa Store Lots and Santa story times at the Kahuku and Waialua libraries.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Haleiwa and the North Shore for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, all of them free. The magic runs from December 11 (Haleiwa Christmas Parade) through December 22 (Santa Claus Story Time at Waialua Public Library), with Surf Santa at Haleiwa Store Lots (December 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Haleiwa

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Haleiwa and the North Shore
  • 3 free events: the Haleiwa Christmas Parade, Surf Santa and the library story times
  • Meet Santa: Surf Santa at Haleiwa Store Lots (December 13) and Santa Claus Story Time in Kahuku (December 21) and Waialua (December 22)
  • Parades: Haleiwa Christmas Parade (December 11, 6:30 pm)
  • Trains: none verified on the North Shore; the Hawaiian Railway Society's Holiday Express is in Ewa Beach
  • Season: December 11 to December 22

Planning a bigger day out? North Shore families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Honolulu, which covers Honolulu City Lights, Kapolei City Lights, the Grinch musical at Diamond Head Theatre, 'Twas the Light Before Christmas on Ice and The Nutcracker.
